title: New Live Poll Lets Pundits Pander To Viewers In Real Time
summary: A 2009 satirical news segment from The Onion's 'In The Know' in which pundits adjust their on-air opinions in real time according to a live viewer poll. It lampoons pandering media and politics.
why: Used as a punchline whenever commenters see consensus-driven decisions, politicians chasing public opinion, or metric-driven content.

quote.text: My favorite bit, still stuck in my head whenever I see politicians from both parties rush to the scene of a protest or whatever
